description: Register a ZocdocResource (OAuth2 client_credentials grant) wrapping Zocdoc's partner-gated Developer Platform API for use by other components. No self-serve signup -- Zocdoc must approve the integration before calls work.

resource_key.label: Resource Key
resource_key.description: Key used to register this resource. Other components reference it via resource_key.

environment.label: Environment
environment.description: 'sandbox' or 'production'. No default -- must be chosen deliberately given production carries real patient-facing data (PHI).

client_id_env_var.label: Client ID Env Var
client_id_env_var.description: Env var holding the Zocdoc OAuth2 Client ID for your partner-gated application.

client_secret_env_var.label: Client Secret Env Var
client_secret_env_var.description: Env var holding the Zocdoc OAuth2 Client Secret.

scope.label: OAuth2 Scope
scope.description: Optional OAuth2 scope to request (e.g. 'offline_access' for a refresh token).

name: Zocdoc Resource
